value.rationale: The canonical outer-circle Toeplitz compression measures interaction of the two annular boundaries. The new result determines an exact finite-width quantitative bound with optimal 1/3 coefficient and upgrades it to an iff Sobolev criterion for arbitrary bounded angular inputs in the thin-annulus limit. Unlike a mere matrix calculation, it exhibits and sharply measures the loss of regularity as the two boundary components pinch.
